description: Plays, matched hosts, tasks (with module and file:line where unambiguous) and tags of a playbook (ansible-playbook --syntax-check, then --list-hosts --list-tasks --list-tags), plus deprecation warnings Ansible printed while parsing; never runs a play. Parses playbooks with Ansible: treat dir as code you would run --syntax-check on (play-level Jinja and playbook-adjacent vars plugins are evaluated); lookups in play-level fields are refused unless ANSIBLE_MCP_ALLOW_PLAY_LOOKUPS=1.

dir.description: Ansible project directory. Default: ANSIBLE_MCP_DIR, else the server's working directory.

name: ansible_playbook_structure
title: Playbook structure
